description: 2025 Nie Table 5, all ten rows. Input-calibrated scenarios are not recovered author data.
reference: Nuclear Engineering and Design 440 (2025) 114138, Table 5, page 12

provenance.capacities_and_targets: Exact Table 5 entries; DPSP/EWP are fractions, not percentage points.
provenance.reserved_rows: Not used in the current fitting objective. Previously inspected in earlier experiments, so not pristine external validation.
provenance.TES_power: Numerical TES power limits are unspecified in Eqs. 19/20. Test absolute MWth and capacity-scaled limits. Scaled values specify MWth at 2000 MWhth and multiply by C_TES/2000.
provenance.PV_interpretation: Area/efficiency versus 150 W nameplate normalization, an unresolved specification conflict.
provenance.finance: Real rate and project horizon are not verified author settings. Keep 20 years and thermal variable-cost units for comparability; fit a shared real rate in the stated bounds. No claim of exhaustive financial search.
provenance.solar_exponent: Analyst-defined peak-preserving irradiance scenario: G'=G_peak*(G/G_peak)^gamma. Preserves night and maximum, changes annual irradiation. Not a published component model or recovered meteorology.
provenance.load_adjustments: Analyst-defined scenario: add one common load offset and adjust the zero-mean 31-day smoothed seasonal component. No independent per-mode or per-row series.
provenance.weather_shift: 0 or +8 hours, applied together to irradiance, temperature and wind using cyclic year boundaries. UTC/local mismatch is a hypothesis based on the hourly profiles, not verified metadata.
provenance.published_parameters: Keep 25 MWth reactor, 40% conversion, initial/minimum 5% TES, zero standing losses, unit TES efficiencies, hydrogen minimum-resource formula, component prices and all Table 5 design/control values unchanged.
provenance.scope: No RL, malfunctions, component-efficiency tuning, or independently fitted mode-specific assumptions.
